answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 36653 Country: India Title: Can I offer any nafl salah between the time starts of Asr and offering fardh Asr salah? When can one perform salah at its beginning time Question: (1) Can I offer any nafl salah between the time starts of Asr and offering fardh Asr salah? When can one perform salah at its beginning time? (2) If I am in a journey by bus, where I cannot perform any salah and if my journey goes on for hours, then when to perform the whole day salahs? Can I offer all those salah before starting the journey? Answer ID: 36653 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 518/247/L=1433) (1) You may offer nafl salah before offering the fardh of Asr though the time of Asr starts already. It is forbidden to offer nafl salah after Asr salah. (2) It is not right to offer all the salah before starting the journey. You should find out some way that you manage to offer each salah in its time. If you do not find time to get down from the bus then offer salah inside the bus. And if you find it hard to offer salah standing in the bus then offer sitting with indication, but in this case you will have to re-offer such salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
